push.title: D 3-3 vs Bluecocks BC | You: 9.0 (3rd best match performance)
push.body:
A 9.0 against Bluecocks BC, BellyTb1. That's the good stuff, the kind you tell your dog about on the drive home.

THE GOOD
+ 89% passing on 27 attempts, up from your usual 74%. Neat, tidy, and not a wasted touch.
+ 3 key passes, the most you've made for us. That's what I call neighborly football.
+ A brace against Bluecocks BC. That's a finish they'll replay at the club banquet.
+ Man of the Match, your 6th for us. Top performer, top teammate.
+ You and PhogsToffees had more chemistry than a high school lab.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Repeat after me: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into. Rome, day by day.
- 3 goals conceded: -0.1. Leaky faucet stuff. Small drips, big bill.
- Worst shot accuracy of your 3 matches this session (80%). Honest truth: that cost us.

Practice plan: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

Before you go, BellyTb1: If it was easy, everybody'd be in Division 1.

If I had a gold star sticker, you'd get the whole sheet. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 7.9. That's your 3rd best match performance. Honest football.

THE GOOD
+ Won 2 of 4 tackles (up from your usual 0%). You knew exactly when to go, and you went.
+ 3 key passes, the most you've made for us. That's a pass with a bow on it.
+ You set it up, BellyTb1 knocked it down. Repeat as needed.
+ 7.9, your 3rd best match performance. Bottle it.
+ On-ball actions 29, up from your usual 22. Small wins add up to big ones.

THE BAD
- Shot conversion 0%, down from your usual 35%. Try this: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
- 3 goals conceded: -0.1. Like leaving the porch light on all day. Small, but it adds up.
- Tackles attempted: 4. One gear up gets you to 6+.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 54% (12 of 22). That's a red-ink, see-me-after-class kind of number. Lesson of the day: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

Skills corner: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.

Listen here, tuxedo_slide: Every pro was once an amateur who didn't quit.

Progress over perfection. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 3-3 vs Bluecocks BC | You: 7.7 (8th best match performance)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.7 is a good day. Not a great one yet, but good is the step before great.

THE GOOD
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. You made the keeper make decisions, and that's the job.
+ 2 key passes. You played the pass before the defense knew it was a possibility.
+ BellyTb1 finished what you started. That's teamwork.
+ Tackle success 40%, up from your usual 15%. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Better match rating than any of their humans (7.7 vs their best 7.5). You earned that one the honest way.

THE BAD
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.7 (best was BellyTb1's 9.0). Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 1). That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.
- Lowest shots on the team: 2 (best was BellyTb1's 5). That's where the match slipped.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 3 (best was BellyTb1's 1). Homework: Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
- Pass accuracy: 76%. 88%+ is where the magic lives.

Practice pointer: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.

Remember, PhogsToffees: Biscuits fix most things. Practice fixes the rest.

Learn it, then leave it. - Coach Lasso
